about: What each robot dimos supports can run, for dimOS Desktop's Launcher and anyone else who wants it. Checked against the code by dimos/gateway/test_robots.py (dimos/gateway/robots.py says how); served by the dimos gateway at GET /dimos/robots.

drive.label: Drive
drive.description: Something in it takes velocity commands (cmd_vel): drive it from an app, the keyboard, a phone or clicks.

map.label: Map
map.description: Builds a map (SLAM, a voxel map or a costmap).

navigate.label: Navigate
navigate.description: Plans and follows paths to a goal, or explores.

perceive.label: Perceive
perceive.description: Cameras plus detection, tracking, memory or a vision-language model.

agent.label: Agent
agent.description: An AI agent (MCP skills) you can talk to.

teleop.label: Teleop
teleop.description: Driven by a person: keyboard, phone, VR headset, remote broker.

record.label: Record
record.description: Records what it sees for later replay or training.

replay.label: Replay
replay.description: Runs on a recording, no hardware (the blueprint has a replay mode).

sim.label: Sim
sim.description: Runs in a simulator, no hardware (the blueprint has a sim mode).

test.label: Test
test.description: A test, benchmark or mock: for developers.
